issues.detail: The Hebrew 'אִם אִדָּרֵשׁ לָכֶם' is an oath formula meaning 'if I am sought by you' (i.e., I will not be sought by you), but the Chinese renders it as '我必不再尋問你們' (I will no longer seek you), reversing the subject-object relationship: in Hebrew, the people seek God, not God seeking them. This changes who is doing the seeking.
